doc.title: Marilyn Crispell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 21, 2022

title: Goodbyes
summary: They say goodbye and Crispell invites Rowe to visit.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Thank you. Well I appreciate the conversation today and I hope you go to your piano and write something new today.
Well I might. I’ve been feeling more like playing than I have this whole time.
Thanks Monk. If you ever come around this area, please give a call, we can actually meet in person.
I will. And I’m just going to pause our recording and then we’ll say good-bye.
